005package org.wpilib.epilogue;
006
007import java.util.HashMap;
008import java.util.IdentityHashMap;
009import java.util.Map;
010import org.wpilib.telemetry.TelemetryTable;
011import org.wpilib.units.Measure;
012import org.wpilib.units.Unit;
013
014/** Utility functions for generated Epilogue telemetry loggers. */
015public final class EpilogueTelemetry {
016  private static final char[] HEX = "0123456789abcdef".toCharArray();
017  private static final Map<Unit, String> s_unitMetadata = new IdentityHashMap<>();
018  private static final Map<String, String> s_symbolMetadata = new HashMap<>();
019
020  private EpilogueTelemetry() {
021    throw new UnsupportedOperationException("This is a utility class!");
022  }
023
024  /**
025   * Returns JSON-encoded unit metadata for the given unit.
026   *
027   * <p>The returned string is suitable for use as the {@code unit} telemetry property value.
028   *
029   * @param unit unit
030   * @return JSON-encoded unit metadata
031   */
032  public static String getUnitMetadata(Unit unit) {
033    synchronized (s_unitMetadata) {
034      String metadata = s_unitMetadata.get(unit);
035      if (metadata != null) {
036        return metadata;
037      }
038      metadata = getUnitMetadata(unit.symbol());
039      s_unitMetadata.put(unit, metadata);
040      return metadata;
041    }
042  }
043
044  /**
045   * Returns JSON-encoded unit metadata for the given unit symbol.
046   *
047   * <p>The returned string is suitable for use as the {@code unit} telemetry property value.
048   *
049   * @param unitSymbol unit symbol
050   * @return JSON-encoded unit metadata
051   */
052  public static String getUnitMetadata(String unitSymbol) {
053    synchronized (s_symbolMetadata) {
054      String metadata = s_symbolMetadata.get(unitSymbol);
055      if (metadata != null) {
056        return metadata;
057      }
058      metadata = jsonString(unitSymbol);
059      s_symbolMetadata.put(unitSymbol, metadata);
060      return metadata;
061    }
062  }
063
064  /**
065   * Logs a measure with unit metadata.
066   *
067   * <p>This logs the measure in terms of its base unit.
068   *
069   * @param table telemetry table
070   * @param name entry name
071   * @param value measure value
072   */
073  public static void logMeasure(TelemetryTable table, String name, Measure<?> value) {
074    Unit baseUnit = value.unit().getBaseUnit();
075    table.setProperty(name, "unit", getUnitMetadata(baseUnit));
076    table.log(name, value.baseUnitMagnitude());
077  }
078
079  private static String jsonString(String value) {
080    StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder(value.length() + 2);
081    out.append('"');
082    for (int i = 0; i < value.length(); i++) {
083      char ch = value.charAt(i);
084      switch (ch) {
085        case '"' -> out.append("\\\"");
086        case '\\' -> out.append("\\\\");
087        case '\b' -> out.append("\\b");
088        case '\f' -> out.append("\\f");
089        case '\n' -> out.append("\\n");
090        case '\r' -> out.append("\\r");
091        case '\t' -> out.append("\\t");
092        default -> {
093          if (ch < 0x20) {
094            out.append("\\u00").append(HEX[ch >>> 4]).append(HEX[ch & 0xf]);
095          } else {
096            out.append(ch);
097          }
098        }
099      }
100    }
101    out.append('"');
102    return out.toString();
103  }
104}
